high_level_description: This image captures a stunning display of the Northern Lights (Aurora Borealis) in a forested area at night. The sky is filled with vibrant green hues, creating a mesmerizing and almost otherworldly atmosphere. The aurora's bright green glow contrasts sharply with the dark silhouette of the trees in the foreground, which appear as a dense forest line. The branches of some trees are visible against the night sky, adding depth to the scene. The setting appears to be remote and natural, likely in a northern region known for aurora sightings.
